name: Alternating Leg Press
steps: Sit with your back and hips pressed firmly against the pad of an independent-leg press machine and plant one foot on each platform.
Brace your core and keep both knees softly unlocked as you hold the platforms in position.
Drive evenly through one foot to press that platform away until your leg is extended without locking the knee hard.
Lower that platform slowly back to the starting bend, then press with the opposite leg, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your pelvis and lower back anchored against the seat pad as each knee bends.
Track each knee in line with your toes rather than letting it cave inward.
